name: shutdown-timer
title: Shutdown Timer
description: Force shut down your Mac after a set time. No app can block the shutdown.
author: merttopuz

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: Shutdown Timer
commands.description: Start a timer that force shuts down this Mac after the given number of minutes. Asks for the administrator password.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Time Remaining
commands.subtitle: Shutdown Timer
commands.description: Show the shutdown time of the active timer and how long is left.

commands.name: cancel
commands.title: Cancel Timer
commands.subtitle: Shutdown Timer
commands.description: Remove the active timer. Asks for the administrator password.
